## Decisions
- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json), NO SQLite — ops backs it up nightly with an rsync job that diffs plain-text files; a binary file breaks their backup checks. Fix slowness by debouncing writes in src/store.ts (mutations within 200 ms -> one write) + flush() on shutdown.
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, NO exponential backoff — because ERP dedups by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land within 2 min or duplicates are created. Delay must be injectable for tests. Retry only network errors + 5xx.
- (user) Tracking-number validation: only carrier ATP is checked (UPU S10 incl. check digit, algorithm in docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and valid DHL numbers were rejected for 2 days last year.
- (user) Austrian public holidays (2026+2027) go in a hardcoded list in new src/services/holidays.ts — because the warehouse deployment has NO outbound internet; no holiday API, must work fully offline.
